title: DJ Tillu
desc: Bala Gangadhar Tilak, also known as DJ Tillu, is a young man who wishes to become a disc jockey someday. However, his life changes after he falls in love with Radhika.

title: Drunken Master
desc: Wong, a playful boy, learns martial arts from a drunk master. He trains hard to stop a deadly assassin and protect those he cares about.

title: Demonte Colony 2
desc: A group of friends who return to a cursed location, driven by curiosity and the quest to uncover the truth behind the malevolent spirits that reside there.

title: The Shallows
desc: After her mother's death, Nancy visits secluded beach. While surfing, a great white shark attacks, leaving her stranded on a rock 200 yards from shore.

title: Sisu
desc: An ex-soldier finds gold in Lapland and tries to bring it to the city, only to be chased and fought by brutal German SS soldiers.

title: Check
desc: Aditya, a conman, is wrongly accused of terrorism by his lover. In prison, he masters chess, becomes a champion, and fights to prove his innocence.

title: Jhund
desc: Vijay Barse, a retired teacher, builds a football team for slum kids to keep them away from crime. He works hard to help them join a national tournament and chase their dreams.

title: Kung Fu Hustle
desc: In Shanghai, China in the 1940s, a wannabe gangster aspires to join the notorious 'Axe Gang' while residents of a housing complex exhibit extraordinary powers in defending their turf.

title: Circle
desc: Circle is a sci-fi mystery about twin brothers linked to an alien girl with tech that records memories, unfolding in two timelines-2017 and 2037-exploring secrets and human emotions.

title: Tuesdays & Fridays
desc: Two millennials get into a relationship where they are allowed to meet only on 'Tuesdays and Fridays'.
